runtime_priority: Existing exterior axis-aligned quads, vertical only, complete 1m by 1m patches. No UV/normal-map/shader substitution for geometric authoring.

candidate_face_contract.coordinate_frame: Source asset local frame; apply rigid instance transform after source-local eligibility. Roof inclinations must not be treated as vertical because of a stair-step riser.
candidate_face_contract.patch_support: All patch corners and edges must remain inside the same exact source quad. No bridging across adjacent faces, missing faces, apertures or holes.
candidate_face_contract.edge_margin_meaning: Zero permits an exact 1m source quad. Module shape itself must stay inside its square; partial borders are left pending.
candidate_face_contract.support_plane: Use support_front_max_local_z_m from the selected module placement contract. Safe modules occupy local z=-0.0375..0.0; placing behind an unchanged face hides relief. Do not guess offset or remove source faces without a separately verified owner-face replacement contract.
candidate_face_contract.no_stacking: Do not apply this baseline mapping a second time to already detailed house adapter replacement faces.
candidate_face_contract.mixed_slot_action: Conditional runtime candidates need per-face filters and visible review; group-level material classification cannot prove each face belongs to a wall.

ashlar.large_face_policy: Partition into fully contained 1 m squares; record uncovered border/feature strips rather than stretch or claim full coverage.
ashlar.semantic_caveat: Source stone/masonry IDs support a masonry substrate; ashlar bond is a proposed finish and still needs visual acceptance.

rubble.large_face_policy: Partition into fully contained 1 m squares; record uncovered border/feature strips rather than stretch or claim full coverage.
rubble.semantic_caveat: No used native slot was found with explicit rubble role evidence. Do not use a dark color or poor-district identity to invent rubble semantics.

planks.large_face_policy: Partition into fully contained 1 m squares; record uncovered border/feature strips rather than stretch or claim full coverage.
planks.semantic_caveat: Class includes timber substrate, structural beams, doors and window joinery. Only source-contained broad faces may use panel seams; narrow joinery is excluded. Bark is pending_unknown.

paving.large_face_policy: Partition into fully contained 1 m squares; record uncovered border/feature strips rather than stretch or claim full coverage.
paving.semantic_caveat: Separate ground/access pass only. Preserve finite collision heights, stair risers, walk clearances and water boundaries; horizontal native tops alone are not all terrain.

roof_tile.semantic_caveat: Semantic covering includes red-clay and gray-slate roof families. Wood-brown palette variants need timber shingle treatment. Shallow modules on coarse risers do not author roof slope, eaves, ridges or silhouette.

plaster.semantic_caveat: No supplied plaster module exists in generated_safe. Keep existing plaster and mark dedicated plaster treatment pending; never substitute masonry.

proposed_runtime_limits.select_priority: Distance to camera, then visible area; do not use material color.
proposed_runtime_limits.when_cap_reached: Record budget_deferred face/area counts and keep baseline rendering. Never count omitted surfaces as upgraded.
proposed_runtime_limits.resource_reuse: Cache each (module kind, seed, material semantic variant); share mesh resources. Do not bake one copy of vertices per city placement.

windows_and_doors.glass: No wall modules on glass, panes, apertures or the dark opening behind them.
windows_and_doors.frames: Window/door frame material slots can mix with larger panels. A >=1m vertical face rule filters many small trims but does not prove that all remaining faces are broad walls. Keep exact original opening limits and classify joinery as conditional.
windows_and_doors.doors: Keep closed leaf geometry and pivots; no filling apertures or connecting neighboring leaves. Hinges/straps remain metal.

gates.rule: Keep passage, arch, portcullis, leaf and lateral clearance. Static masonry jambs may use source-contained squares only. Moving leaf/hardware needs its own parent/pivot, not a world-fixed shared facade.

water.rule: No ashlar/rubble/plank fill on water or foam. Preserve thin flow surfaces, basin outlets, canal widths and existing exclusion from terrain collision.

foliage.rule: Do not resurface crowns, hedge lobes or ground vegetation with stone/planks. Bark slots are explicit unknown because requested classes contain no bark; preserve them pending a foliage/bark authoring pass.

cloth.rule: Canvas/sails/awnings require a separate thin-shell treatment; retain hang, seams, gaps and front/back visibility. Do not tile cloth with rigid wall blocks.

metal.rule: No wall module on chains, braces, fittings, nails, bronze outlets or handles; preserve apertures and mechanism connectivity.

moving_drawbridge.rule: Exclude all drawbridge_state_components from this static wall layer. Current ROAD_OPEN is a static state and motion_enabled=false, not proof of functioning animation. Later detail must follow state-local parent/pivot transforms and clearance through every mechanism state.

terrain.rule: This native asset map does not cover 1,397,505 terrain triangle records or 90,901 collision-contract triangles. They need a separate ownership/material surface workflow. Do not claim native wall coverage as city surface completion.

roofs.rule: All roof-bearing source assets remain pending silhouette and feature authoring/review. No surface overlay can establish replacement of original 0.5m or 1m stair-step silhouettes.

release_gates: All 300 used keys are present and all source hashes still match.
Every applied, skipped, unsupported and budget-deferred slot/face has explicit evidence counts.
Mixed-role slots inspected for opening, threshold, gate and trim preservation.
Dedicated roof, paving/terrain, plaster, water, foliage, cloth and mechanism authoring paths have review evidence.
In-engine near and far visual review plus traversal/performance evidence exists.
No map/overlay status is promoted to whole-city completion.
